The '''Devious Creep''' was a domesticated bipedal [[Species/Legends|creature]] that could serve as a companion<ref name="Reveal" /> around [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}} mentions that the [[Dantooine Incursion]] took place in 3627 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref>

{{Creature-stub}}
